name: Bristol

queries.query: Bristol City Council cadastral parcel boundaries land registry INSPIRE index polygons official
queries.scope: Identify Bristol-specific public land parcel/registry mapping and distinguish legal parcel extents from title-index polygons.
queries.result: HM Land Registry publishes INSPIRE Index Polygons as a freehold registered-property index with a download file per local authority, including Bristol. Its documentation cautions the file is not a legal boundary dataset; polygons on LA borders may occur in both files. Bristol City Council’s public INSPIRE map service lists thematic layers, including council asset land ownership, but no general cadastral parcel fabric.

queries.query: Bristol official land registry index polygon download local authority HMLR WFS WMS queryable boundary semantics
queries.scope: Trace official local-authority download and WMS feature access.
queries.result: The official HMLR download page route redirected in the web tool; no Bristol GML was retrieved. The official INSPIRE WMS advertises the cadastral parcel map as non-queryable, so it provides map imagery, not a full polygon response. HMLR records are registered-freehold index polygons, not legally authoritative boundaries.

coverageAssessment.claimedScope: Registered freehold property index polygons in the Bristol local-authority file.
coverageAssessment.verifiedOpenScope: Official dataset description states files are divided by local authority and that boundary polygons may appear in two files. Bristol is listed as a local authority in HMLR’s download catalogue. The WMS is not queryable and the download route did not yield GML in this session.
coverageAssessment.titleIndexSemantics: A registered-freehold index map, not a legal boundary or complete all-tenure cadastral fabric; do not treat polygon overlap/duplicity as parcel holdings.
